summary: Cell size, tilt and X-ray microscopy of real honeybee combs are open in one CC0 Dryad archive, and cell orientation of natural combs in another. Wall thickness, wax mass and base-angle tables were not confirmed in any file list, and the optimum itself is a mathematical comparison rather than a dataset.
